name: Amano Rina
source:
Shiori's sister and protagonist's cousin. A spirited girl with petite body who does all the house work of "Shooting Star Garden", alone. Always has her hamster "Jinpachi", on her head. 

Her dream is to become the protagonist's wife!

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050430194905/http://210.166.209.38:80/html/soft/flove/chara_d.htm]website[/url]]
